DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 副業の広告とのやり取りについて、ご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You want advice about your exchanges concerning a side-job advertisement, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 何も送っていないと先ほど言いましたが、履歴を見たら名前と電話番号を送っていました。訂正したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未提供申告を名前電話送信済へ訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I said earlier that I hadn't sent anything, but when I checked the history, I had sent my name and phone number. I'd like to correct that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Correct your claim of sending nothing to say you sent your name and phone number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 分かりました。送った内容を、履歴で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Understood. Let's check what you sent in the history.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この送信欄に名前と番号があります。住所は途中まで入力しましたが、送信せず消しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 送信済情報と住所下書きを分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: My name and number are in this sent field. I partly entered my address, but deleted it without sending.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the sent information from the address draft. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 相手からは、その後どんな返事がありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: What reply did they send afterward?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日中に登録料を払えば仕事を渡すという返事です。金額を見て不安になり、ここへ来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 登録料を急がせる相手の返事を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: They replied that they'd give me work if I paid a registration fee today. The amount worried me, so I came here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the reply pressuring you to pay a registration fee. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 支払いの操作はしましたか。送った情報とは分けて伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Did you perform any payment operation? I'm asking separately from the information you sent.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 払っていません。送信した個人情報はありますが、お金を送った履歴はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 情報送信と金銭未送金を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I haven't paid. I have sent personal information, but there's no history of sending money.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish sending information from not transferring money. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 広告の表示とやり取りを確認します。今も相手から連絡がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check the advertisement and your exchanges. Are they still contacting you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 未読のメッセージが二件あります。急いで返事をせず、送った名前と番号、未送信の住所、未払いを分けて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未読連絡と三種の実際の状態を整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: There are two unread messages. I won't rush to reply; I'll explain separately the name and number I sent, the unsent address, and the unpaid fee.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Organize the unread contacts and the three actual statuses. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 訂正した内容も記録します。それでは、履歴を順に伺います。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll record the correction too. Now I'll ask about the history in order. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お送りになる物は、この紙の作品ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this paper artwork what you want to send?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。子どもが作った立体の家です。封筒へ入れるため、屋根を少し押しても大丈夫でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 立体作品の屋根を押して封筒に入れる案を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, a three-dimensional house my child made. Would it be all right to press the roof a little to fit it in an envelope?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about pressing the three-dimensional artwork's roof to put it in an envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 押すと形が変わりそうですね。形を保ちたい物は、その状態に合う梱包をご自身でご用意ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Pressing it looks likely to change its shape. For something you want to keep in shape, please prepare suitable packaging yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 屋根をつぶしたくありません。用意した封筒は使わず、箱を探します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 形を保つため封筒をやめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I don't want to crush the roof. I'll find a box instead of using the envelope I prepared.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give up the envelope to preserve the shape. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今の作品の高さに加えて、周囲を保護する余地も必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Besides the artwork's current height, you need room around it for protection.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家に靴箱がありますが、作品を入れると屋根がふたに当たります。それも小さいのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 手持ち靴箱で屋根がふたに当たると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have a shoebox at home, but when the artwork is inside, the roof touches the lid. So that's too small too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the roof touches the lid in your shoebox. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 作品に合う箱へ梱包してから、重さや大きさに応じた送り方を確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once it's packed in a suitable box, we can check shipping options according to weight and size.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は持ち帰って、もう少し高さのある箱を用意します。中で作品が動かないかも確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 高い箱を用意し中の動きを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll take it home today and prepare a slightly taller box. I'll also check that the artwork doesn't move inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Prepare a taller box and check movement inside. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 梱包前に料金や到着日を確定することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can't finalize the price or arrival date before packaging.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 箱に入れた状態で再相談します。祖母には、作品を壊さず送る準備のため発送が遅れると伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 梱包後再相談と祖母への遅延連絡を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll consult again with it boxed. I'll tell my grandmother shipping will be delayed while I prepare to send the artwork without breaking it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you will consult after packaging and tell your grandmother about the delay. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、作品を大切にお持ち帰りください。またお待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please take the artwork home carefully. We look forward to seeing you again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お振込みの控えについて、ご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about the transfer receipt?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 先週払った代金の案内が、またメールで来ました。同じ金額なので、もう一度払う必要があるか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 再送請求メールで再支払必要か相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've received another email requesting payment of a bill I paid last week. It's the same amount, so I'm unsure whether I need to pay again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether another payment is necessary after a repeated billing email. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 銀行では請求の内容や重複を判断できません。先週の取引の控えはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The bank cannot determine the bill's contents or whether it's a duplicate. Do you have last week's transaction receipt?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。メールにある番号と控えの番号は種類が違い、その番号だけでは同じ支払か分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 控えとメール番号の種類違いを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. The email number and receipt number are different types, so those numbers alone don't show whether it's the same payment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show that the email and receipt numbers are different types. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 日付、金額、受取先をご確認ください。請求先への確認も必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the date, amount, and recipient. You'll also need to check with the biller.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 先週の金額と受取先は一致します。でも今のメールが別の注文分かもしれないので、まだ再振込はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 日付金額受取先一致でも別注文可能性で再送金保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: The amount and recipient match last week's. But this email might be for a different order, so I won't transfer again yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Hold off another transfer despite matching date, amount, and recipient because it might be another order. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 取引の記録について確認したい部分はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is there anything about the transaction record you'd like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この控えが操作途中の紙なのか、受け付けられた取引の控えなのかを確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 控えが取引受付記録か操作途中かを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to know whether this is a paper from an unfinished operation or a receipt for an accepted transaction.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether the receipt records an accepted transaction or an operation still in progress. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当がこの記録の状態を確認します。ただし、請求先が入金を何に充てたかは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will check this record's status. But we can't tell what the biller applied the payment to.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 記録の状態を聞いてから、請求先へ先週の日付と金額を伝えます。確認前に同額をもう一度送ることはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 銀行記録状態確認後に請求先へ照会する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: After hearing the record's status, I'll tell the biller last week's date and amount. I won't send the same amount again before confirming.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the bank record's status, then inquire with the biller. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、取引記録の確認へおつなぎします。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll connect you to have the transaction record checked. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計は終わりました。かごをこちらへどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Checkout is complete. Please put the basket here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません。かごの下に洗剤が一本残っていました。食品だけを出して、これを見落としていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: かご底の洗剤を出し忘れたと申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Sorry, a bottle of detergent was left at the bottom. I only took out the food and overlooked it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that you forgot to take the detergent out of the basket's bottom. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: レシートを確認しましょう。こちらの商品は記載されていませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the receipt. This item isn't listed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 気付いたのは今です。袋へ隠したのではなく、かごの底に置いたままでした。追加で払いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 気付いた時点と追加支払希望を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I only noticed just now. I didn't hide it in a bag; it was still at the bottom of the basket. I'd like to pay for it additionally.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain when you noticed and that you want to pay additionally. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらで別にお会計します。食品と一緒の袋へお入れしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll ring it up separately here. Shall I put it in the same bag as the food?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 洗剤は食品と分けます。小さい袋を持っているので、店の袋は要りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持参袋で洗剤と食品を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll keep the detergent separate from the food. I have a small bag, so I don't need a store bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Use your own bag to separate detergent from food. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 追加のお会計は三百八十円です。先ほどと同じ方法でお支払いになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: The additional amount is three hundred eighty yen. Will you pay the same way as before?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今度は現金で払います。五百円を出しますので、お釣りをお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 五百円現金で追加代金を払う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll pay cash this time. Here's five hundred yen; please give me change.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Pay the additional charge with five hundred yen cash. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 百二十円のお返しです。追加分のレシートもお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here's one hundred twenty yen change. I'll also give you the additional receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 百二十円受け取りました。二枚のレシートを保管し、洗剤は小さい袋に入れて帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 釣銭百二十円と二枚のレシートを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've received one hundred twenty yen. I'll keep both receipts and take the detergent home in the small bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm one hundred twenty yen change and two receipts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お知らせいただきありがとうございます。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for letting us know. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日の体操会で、最初の説明をお願いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Could you give the initial explanation at today's exercise session?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 参加経験はありますが、皆さんへ動きを教えたことはありません。説明役を引き受ける前に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 経験は参加のみで説明役を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've attended before, but I've never taught the movements to others. I'd like to discuss it before accepting the explanation role.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your experience is only participation and discuss the explanation role. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: いつもの先生が遅れるため、最初の動きをご存じかと思ってお声掛けしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The usual teacher is running late, so I asked thinking you might know the opening movements.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 順番は少し覚えていますが、腕をどこまで上げるかは曖昧です。参加したことと正しく教えられることは別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 覚えた順序と曖昧な動作から指導不能を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I remember some of the sequence, but I'm unsure how high to raise the arms. Having attended and being able to teach correctly are different.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you cannot instruct because you only partly remember the sequence and the movements are unclear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では体操の開始は先生を待ちます。受付で参加者の名前を確認する補助はいかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then we'll wait for the teacher to start. How about helping check participants' names at reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それならできます。体操の代わりに、自分で別の運動を考えて始めることはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受付補助を選び代わりの運動を創作しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can do that. I won't invent another exercise and start it instead of the planned exercises.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose reception help and do not invent replacement exercises. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 受付表はこちらです。初めての方へ開始が遅れることをお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here's the reception list. Tell newcomers that the start will be delayed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 名簿を見て確認します。遅れた理由を私が推測せず、先生の到着を待って開始すると伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 名簿確認と開始延期を理由推測なしで伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll check against the list. I won't guess why they're late; I'll say we'll start after waiting for the teacher to arrive.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the list and explain the delayed start without guessing the reason. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 先生が到着しました。受付の続きをお願いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: The teacher has arrived. Could you continue at reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 続けます。動きの質問が来たら先生へつなぎ、私は出欠の確認だけを担当します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 先生到着後も出欠担当と動作質問取次を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will. If anyone asks about movements, I'll refer them to the teacher and only handle attendance checks myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After the teacher arrives, keep responsibility for attendance and refer movement questions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 役割を相談してくださり助かりました。それでは、受付をよろしくお願いします。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for discussing your role. Please take care of reception, then. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 運行案内をお待ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you waiting for service information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 表示に「十時に再案内」とあります。十時に列車が出るという意味ですか。迎えを頼んでいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 再案内十時を発車時刻か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: The display says, “Another update at ten.” Does that mean the train leaves at ten? I've asked someone to pick me up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the ten o'clock update means departure time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 十時は次の案内をする予定で、発車時刻ではありません。発車の見込みはまだ出ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Ten is when we plan to give the next update, not a departure time. We don't yet have an estimated departure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 迎えの人へ十時発と送るところでした。まだ出発が決まっていないと伝え直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 迎えへの誤った時刻通知を取りやめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I was about to tell my ride it leaves at ten. I'll correct that and say departure hasn't been decided yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Stop sending an incorrect time to the person collecting you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 次の案内はこちらの表示と放送でお知らせします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll give the next update on this display and over the announcement system.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ホームへ降りて待つより、この表示の近くにいた方がよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 待機する場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Would it be better to stay near this display rather than go down to the platform to wait?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask where to wait. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現在はこちらでお待ちいただいています。ホームへ進む案内が出てからお移りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We're currently asking people to wait here. Please move after instructions to proceed to the platform are given.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ここで待ちます。迎えの人には、到着時刻が分かるまで家で待ってもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 表示付近で待ち迎えを自宅待機にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll wait here. I'll ask my ride to wait at home until the arrival time is known.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Wait near the display and have your ride wait at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 十時になっても、状況によっては時刻を確定できない場合があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Even at ten, depending on the situation, we may not be able to confirm a time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 再案内で分かった内容をそのまま伝えます。発車が決まってから、到着の見込みも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 次の更新内容と到着見込みを分けて確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll pass on exactly what the next update says. Once departure is decided, I'll check the estimated arrival too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the next update separately from estimated arrival. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、次の案内をお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please wait for the next update. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約の受付ですね。お名前を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're checking in for a reservation, correct? May I have your name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: リンと申します。電話で予約した時、確認のメールには「リム」と書かれていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約メールの名前の読み違いを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: My name is Rin. When I booked by phone, the confirmation email said “Rimu.”
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the wrong reading of your name in the reservation email. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 名前だけでは判断できませんので、予約日時と番号を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can't determine it by name alone, so please give the reservation date, time, and number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 木曜の午後二時、番号は五十二です。「リム」という別の方の予約なら、変更しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 日時番号を示し別人予約変更を避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thursday at two in the afternoon, number fifty-two. If it's another person named Rimu's reservation, please don't change it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give date, time, and number and avoid changing someone else's reservation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 番号と日時が一致しています。メールアドレスの一部も照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The number, date, and time match. I'll also compare part of the email address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 末尾は数字の八です。こちらのメール画面を、ほかの方に見えないようお見せします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: メール末尾照合を周囲へ隠して行う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: It ends with the digit eight. I'll show you this email screen so others can't see it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Compare the email ending while shielding it from people nearby. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご本人の予約と確認できました。読みを「リン」へ訂正します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We've confirmed it's your reservation. I'll correct the reading to Rin.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。漢字の欄は空欄のままで、ローマ字のつづりは今の登録を残してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 読みだけ変更し綴りを残すよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. Please leave the kanji field blank and keep the currently registered Roman-letter spelling.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to change only the reading and preserve the spelling. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 読みだけ訂正しました。予約日時の変更はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I've corrected only the reading. The reservation date and time haven't changed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 木曜二時のままですね。当日は訂正した名前と予約番号の両方で受付します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 日時据置と当日名前番号で受付を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Still Thursday at two, right? On the day, I'll check in using both the corrected name and reservation number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the unchanged date and time and checking in with name and number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、ご予約の日にお待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We look forward to seeing you on your reservation day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お渡しした書類について、ご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about the documents we gave you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 封筒と一枚の紙を受け取りました。紙には予約日時があり、封筒には宛名があります。両方私が読む物ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 宛名付き封書と予約紙の用途を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I received an envelope and one sheet. The sheet has the appointment date and time, and the envelope has an addressee. Am I meant to read both?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask the purposes of the addressed sealed envelope and appointment sheet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 紙はご本人の予約案内です。封筒は紹介先へお渡しする書類です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: The sheet is your appointment information. The envelope contains documents to hand to the referral destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 内容を確かめるために封を開けようとしていました。紹介先へ渡す物なら、このまま持っていきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 開封せず紹介先へ持参する判断を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I was about to open it to check the contents. If it's for the referral destination, I'll take it as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Decide to take the envelope to the referral destination unopened. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、封をした状態で受付へお出しください。説明が必要な内容は担当へ確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, hand it to reception sealed. You can ask the person in charge about anything that needs explaining.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 封筒の宛名は予約案内の病院名と同じです。ただ、予約の日まで家で保管してよいか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 宛名一致と予約日までの保管を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: The addressee on the envelope matches the hospital name in the appointment information. I just want to confirm I can store it at home until the appointment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the matching addressee and storage until the appointment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 濡らしたり折り曲げたりしないよう保管して、予約日にお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Keep it from getting wet or folded, and bring it on your appointment day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 書類用の袋に入れます。本人用の予約案内は封筒に入れず、日時を見られるよう分けておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 封書保護と予約案内の別保管を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll put it in a document bag. I won't put my appointment information inside the envelope; I'll keep it separate so I can check the date and time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain protecting the sealed envelope and storing appointment information separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ほかの持ち物は予約案内にあります。分からない部分があればお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Other things to bring are listed in the appointment information. Ask if anything is unclear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 持ち物の欄も読みます。病院へ着いたら、紹介の封筒を受付へ渡し、案内紙は手元で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 持物確認と当日の封書手渡しを整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll read that list too. At the hospital I'll give reception the referral envelope and keep the information sheet to check myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Organize checking what to bring and handing over the sealed envelope on the day. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、書類をお忘れにならないようになさってください。お大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please don't forget the documents. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 先ほどの鍵の届け出について、追加のお話でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this additional information about the key report from earlier?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。三本と伝えましたが、家族に写真を送ってもらうと四本でした。訂正できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 鍵本数を三から四へ訂正希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I said three keys, but when my family sent a photo, there were four. Can I correct it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to correct the key count from three to four. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真は、なくす前の鍵束を写した物ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does the photo show the key ring before it was lost?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 先週の写真です。昨日まで鍵を抜いたり増やしたりしていません。小さい鍵を数え忘れていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 写真時点と増減なしと数え忘れを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's from last week. I hadn't removed or added keys up to yesterday. I forgot to count the small key.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the photo's timing, no additions or removals, and the missed count. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 訂正する情報と、その根拠を記録します。鍵の形も違いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll record the corrected information and its basis. Are the key shapes different too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 長い鍵が二本、丸い持ち手の鍵が一本、小さい銀色の鍵が一本です。小さい物は箱の鍵です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 鍵四本の形と用途を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Two long keys, one with a round handle, and one small silver key. The small one is for a box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the shapes and purpose of the four keys. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 付いている飾りの説明は、先ほどのままでよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Should we keep the description of the attached decoration as before?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 青い布の飾りは変わりません。四本という数だけで、ほかの特徴まで変えないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 飾り情報は変えず訂正範囲を限定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: The blue cloth decoration is unchanged. Please don't change the other features just because the count is four.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Keep the decoration information and limit the correction's scope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 本数と内訳を直しました。写真の保存もお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I've corrected the number and breakdown. Please keep the photo too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 写真は消さず残します。見つかったという連絡があれば、今の四本の内訳で照合をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 写真保存と訂正内訳による照合を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't delete it. If there's a report that they've been found, please compare them against this revised four-key breakdown.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the photo and request comparison against the corrected breakdown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、追加のご連絡ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Thank you for the additional information. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不在票についてのお問い合わせですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're asking about the missed-delivery notice, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 来週の火曜に家にいます。でも、この紙の保管期限は日曜です。火曜に届けてもらう入力はできませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 期限後の希望日と入力不能を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'll be home next Tuesday. But this notice's storage deadline is Sunday. I couldn't enter Tuesday for delivery.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your desired date after the deadline and inability to enter it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通知に記載された期限を確認します。今日までに受け取れる日はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check the deadline on the notice. Are there any days up to today when you can receive it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日も明日も遅くなります。日曜は出張中で、家には誰もいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 期限内は出張等で受取不能と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll be late today and tomorrow. On Sunday I'm away on business, and nobody will be home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that business travel and other commitments prevent receipt within the deadline. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この窓口では、ご希望の日まで保管できるとは約束できません。通知の取扱先へ確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: This counter can't promise storage until your requested date. You'll need to check with the office handling the notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 日にちを書き換えて申し込むのはやめます。問い合わせる時は、追跡番号と期限を伝えればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通知の日付を変えず番号期限で照会する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't change the date on the notice to apply. When inquiring, should I give the tracking number and deadline?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Inquire using the number and deadline without changing the notice's date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。受け取れる日も一緒にお伝えください。送った方が分かれば、そちらにも状況をご連絡ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, and also tell them when you can receive it. If you know the sender, inform them of the situation too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 送り主は姉です。期限後ならどうなるか確認してから、姉にも出張で受け取れないと知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 期限後対応の確認と姉への事情連絡を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: My older sister sent it. After checking what happens after the deadline, I'll tell her I can't receive it because of business travel.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check handling after the deadline and inform your older sister of the situation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 本人でない方の受取りなども、取扱条件の確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: For receipt by someone other than you too, the handling conditions must be checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 同僚へ取りに行ってもらえると決め付けません。まず取扱先へ、私の状況で可能な方法を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同僚受取りを断定せず条件照会する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't assume a colleague can collect it. First I'll ask the handling office what options are possible in my situation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not assume a colleague can collect it; inquire about conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、通知をお持ちのうえご確認ください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24214-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please have the notice with you when checking. Goodbye.
